# 🧱 SPIKE examples: Sharpshooter Vision Universal v1

[🔙 Back to Sharpshooter Vision Universal v1](/en/sensors/unicam/index.md)　｜　[How SPIKE reads it](/en/sensors/unicam/spike/index.md)　｜　[📋 Value reference](/en/sensors/unicam/reference.md)

> [!WARNING]
> **v1 not yet hardware-verified**: the value layout is final and passed computer tests; real-hardware numbers (fps, line thresholds, I2C pins) may change after bench testing.

This page has **5 Pybricks examples** (with the MBC library `MBC_UniCam.py`) and **2 LEGO SPIKE App (Education) Python examples**, plus a table for the official App blocks (Education and Robot Inventor). The tasks are the ones students use most: turn to follow a blob, find several colours, read the colour at a spot, colour order (WRO), PD line following with a stop at a junction.

| Way | For whom | How |
|---|---|---|
| 🐍 **Pybricks** (Python) | You want every value (14 colours, counts, 14 line values) | Open [code.pybricks.com](https://code.pybricks.com) → "Import a file" → import the example **and** [`MBC_UniCam.py`](/examples/unicam/pybricks/MBC_UniCam.py) → open the example → ▶ |
| 🟨 **LEGO SPIKE App 3 (Education) Python** | School SPIKE App, no firmware change | New "Python" project → paste the whole example → ▶ (the reading helper is already at the top) |
| 🟨 Official App blocks (Education / Robot Inventor) | Blocks only | Use the colour, reflection and raw red/green/blue blocks with the [table at the bottom](#app-table) |

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Pybricks cannot read the camera's current mode**: `mode=13` in the program must match the camera menu (mode number = camera mode × 10 + option; colour order = 30). A wrong mode gives jumping numbers, not an error.
> - Pybricks needs the Pybricks firmware on the hub (install it from code.pybricks.com; the SPIKE App can put LEGO firmware back). The official App needs nothing.
> - The camera must run the **SPIKE firmware**. It detects by itself whether the hub runs the official App or Pybricks.

📦 All host libraries in one download: [MBC_UniCam_v1_Host_Libraries.zip](/downloads/MBC_UniCam_v1_Host_Libraries.zip) (Pybricks, EV3, SPIKE App, Arduino, micro:bit, MATRIX)

## Before you start: teach colours and set the mode on the camera

1. **Teach a colour**: on the live view use left/right to stop on "target 1" → **OK** → move the cross onto the colour (AxisX → AxisY) → **OK** (hold OK for 0.8 s to finish at once). Do the same for target 2, 3… The **side key** on a target clears it.
2. **Set the mode**: left/right to **MODE** → **OK** → camera mode 1~4 → **OK** → option → **OK**. Options show how many values this hub really gets (for example Pybricks "7 XY"). "1-3" at the top right of the screen is the current mode (= mode number 13).
3. Settings survive power-off (colours, mode, options).

| Mode number | Camera menu | What Pybricks gets |
|---|---|---|
| 11 | 1 Colour tracking, 1 Max | 14 colour positions (16×12 grid, library turns it into pixels ±5); counts via mode 6 |
| 12 | 1 Colour tracking, 2 Multi | 7 colours X, Y (pixels); counts via mode 6 |
| 13 | 1 Colour tracking, 3 Standard | 4 colours X, Y, area %, count |
| 14 | 1 Colour tracking, 4 Fine | 2 colours X, Y, width, height, count, area %; colours found |
| 21 / 22 / 23 | 2 Spot colour, 1/2/3 | 14 spots hue / 7 spots hue + sat / 4 spots hue + sat + val |
| 30 | 3 Colour order | hue codes of 13 blocks from the left + total |
| 41 / 42 / 43 | 4 Line: black / white / colour | 14 values (near/mid/far offset, angle, width, flags, junction, edges, markers, lost side) |

**Reading the numbers**: pixels, X 0~159 (left → right), Y 0~119 (top → bottom), **(0, 0) = not found**. Hue code 0~255: red 0/240, yellow 40, green 80, cyan 120, blue 160, purple 200; 241~248 white/grey; 249~255 black. Line offsets −100~100: **standing behind the robot, line on the left = negative**.

## MBC_UniCam.py methods

`cam = UniCam(Port.C, mode=13)` (port can also be 1~6; `UniCam(Port.C, 13, True)` = multitask, `await` every method)

| Method | Returns | Modes |
|---|---|---|
| `xy(c)`, `x(c)`, `y(c)`, `found(c)` | (X, Y) pixels of colour c, found or not | 11~14 |
| `area(c)` | area (% of the picture) | 13, 14 |
| `size(c)` | (width, height) pixels | 14 |
| `count(c)` | number of blobs of colour c (mode 11: 0~7, mode 6) | 11~14 |
| `colors_found()` | how many of the 16 colours are found (11, 12 read mode 6) | 11, 12, 14 |
| `cell(c)` | 16×12 grid cell (1~16, 1~12) | 11 |
| `max_color()` / `max_point()` | colours / spots in this mode | 1x / 2x |
| `hue(i)`, `sat(i)`, `val(i)`, `hsv(i)`, `color(i)` | hue code, saturation, value, colour name of spot i | 21~23 |
| `order()`, `total()` | hue codes from the left (≤13), total blocks | 30 |
| `line_all()` | all 14 values at once | 41~43 |
| `near()` `mid()` `far()` `angle()` `width()` `flags()` `junction()` `junction_dist()` `edges()` `far_width()` `marker()` `lost()` | single line values | 41~43 |
| `device_id()`, `is_unicam()`, `firmware_version()` | mode 8: (0x4C, 3, 100), True, (1, 0) | all |
| `sensor_ok()`, `mode_number()` | last read OK, mode number given | all |
| `color_name(h)` (module function) | hue code → `'red'` … `'black'` | — |

- A method that the mode does not have (for example `xy()` in mode 21) or a colour number out of range raises `ValueError` with a bilingual message; it never returns a wrong value silently.
- Unplugging does not stop the program: you get the last value; `None` if it was never read.
- Counts (modes 11, 12) are in mode 6 and the device ID in mode 8. A mode switch costs about 30 ms, so do not read them every loop.

---

## Example 1: turn to follow a colour blob

**What it does**: the robot turns toward colour 1 (left → turn left, right → turn right) while driving forward; when the area is big (close) it only turns; when nothing is seen it spins slowly to search.

**Camera mode**: camera mode 1 Colour tracking, option 3 Standard (XY + area) = **mode number 13**; teach "target 1" first.

**You need**: SPIKE hub, driving base (left wheel **E**, right wheel **F**), camera in port **C**, a ball or brick of the target colour.

**Download**: [ex01_track_turn.py](/examples/unicam/pybricks/ex01_track_turn.py) + [MBC_UniCam.py](/examples/unicam/pybricks/MBC_UniCam.py)

<details>
<summary>🐍 Pybricks code</summary>

```python
# 神攝手通用版 v1 × Pybricks（SPIKE）範例 1：跟著色塊轉
# Sharpshooter Vision Universal v1 × Pybricks (SPIKE) example 1: turn to follow a colour blob
# 需要把相機選單切到 相機模式 1 顏色追蹤 ・子選項 ③ 標準（XY＋面積）＝模式編號 13
# Camera menu: camera mode 1 Colour tracking, option 3 Standard (XY + area) = mode number 13
# 準備：先在相機上教「目標 1」的顏色 / Teach "target 1" on the camera first
# 接線 Wiring：相機 → C 孔 / camera → port C；左輪 E、右輪 F / left wheel E, right wheel F
# 同一個資料夾要有 MBC_UniCam.py / MBC_UniCam.py must be imported too
from pybricks.hubs import PrimeHub
from pybricks.pupdevices import Motor
from pybricks.parameters import Port, Direction, Color
from pybricks.robotics import DriveBase
from pybricks.tools import wait
from MBC_UniCam import UniCam

hub = PrimeHub()
cam = UniCam(Port.C, mode=13)                    # 模式編號要跟相機選單一樣 / must match the camera menu
left = Motor(Port.E, Direction.COUNTERCLOCKWISE)
right = Motor(Port.F)
robot = DriveBase(left, right, 56, 112)          # 輪徑 56 mm、輪距 112 mm / wheel 56 mm, axle 112 mm

KP = 3            # 👉 可以改：偏 1 像素就多轉幾度／秒 / you can change: turn rate per pixel of error
STOP_AREA = 20    # 👉 可以改：面積 ≥ 20 % 就算很近 / area (%) that counts as "close"

while True:
    p = cam.xy(1)                                # 色 1 的 (X, Y) 像素；(0, 0) = 沒看到 / (0, 0) = not seen
    if p is None:                                # 從來沒讀到相機 / camera never answered
        robot.stop()
        hub.light.on(Color.RED)
    elif p[0] == 0:                              # 沒看到色 1：原地慢慢轉著找 / not seen: spin slowly to search
        robot.drive(0, 60)
        hub.light.on(Color.ORANGE)
    else:
        error = p[0] - 80                        # 畫面中間 X = 80；色塊在右 → 正 / centre is X = 80; right = positive
        if cam.area(1) >= STOP_AREA:             # 很近了：只轉不前進 / close: turn only
            robot.drive(0, error * KP)
        else:                                    # 還遠：邊前進邊轉 / far: drive and turn
            robot.drive(80, error * KP)
        hub.light.on(Color.GREEN)
    wait(20)
```

</details>

**Step by step**
1. `UniCam(Port.C, mode=13)`: tells the library the camera is in mode 13 (SPIKE cannot read it, you type it).
2. `cam.xy(1)`: (X, Y) of colour 1 in pixels. X = 0 means not seen.
3. `error = X − 80`: the centre is 80; right of centre is positive → `robot.drive(speed, error × KP)` positive turn = turn right.
4. `cam.area(1)`: area %, in the same packet as X and Y (mode 9), no extra wait.

**What you should see**: ball on the left → the robot turns left; on the right → turns right; ball close (area ≥ 20 %) → it turns on the spot; no ball → orange light and it spins to search.

**Common problems**
- **Turns the wrong way?** → swap the E and F cables, or move `Direction.COUNTERCLOCKWISE` to the right motor.
- **Always searching?** → the camera screen should show `1-3`; target 1 must be taught; `mode=` must match the menu.
- **Wobbles left and right?** → make `KP` smaller (for example 2).

## Example 2: where are my colours?

**What it does**: every 0.5 s it prints where colours 1~7 are (left/middle/right, top/middle/bottom); the hub screen shows how many are seen. Press the hub's **left button** to also print "colours found out of 16" and "blobs of colour 1".

**Camera mode**: camera mode 1 Colour tracking, option 2 Multi = **mode number 12**; teach targets 1~7 (any number).

**You need**: SPIKE hub, camera in port **C**, bricks of a few colours.

**Download**: [ex02_multi_color.py](/examples/unicam/pybricks/ex02_multi_color.py) + [MBC_UniCam.py](/examples/unicam/pybricks/MBC_UniCam.py)

<details>
<summary>🐍 Pybricks code</summary>

```python
# 神攝手通用版 v1 × Pybricks（SPIKE）範例 2：多色找位置
# Sharpshooter Vision Universal v1 × Pybricks (SPIKE) example 2: where are my colours?
# 需要把相機選單切到 相機模式 1 顏色追蹤 ・子選項 ② 多色 ＝模式編號 12（SPIKE 給 7 色的 X、Y）
# Camera menu: camera mode 1 Colour tracking, option 2 Multi = mode number 12 (7 colours, X and Y)
# 準備：在相機上教目標 1～7 的顏色（教幾色都可以）/ teach targets 1~7 (any number)
# 接線 Wiring：相機 → C 孔 / camera → port C
from pybricks.hubs import PrimeHub
from pybricks.parameters import Port, Button
from pybricks.tools import wait
from MBC_UniCam import UniCam

hub = PrimeHub()
cam = UniCam(Port.C, mode=12)


def where(x, y):
    # 像素 → 文字：左／中／右 + 上／中／下 / pixels -> words
    h = '左 left' if x < 54 else ('右 right' if x > 106 else '中 middle')
    v = '上 top' if y < 40 else ('下 bottom' if y > 80 else '中 middle')
    return h + ', ' + v


while True:
    seen = 0
    for c in range(1, cam.max_color() + 1):      # 色 1～7 / colours 1~7
        p = cam.xy(c)
        if p and p[0]:                           # X = 0 表示沒找到 / X = 0 means not found
            seen += 1
            print('色 colour', c, ':', p[0], p[1], where(p[0], p[1]))
    hub.display.number(seen)                     # 主機螢幕顯示看到幾色 / show how many colours are seen
    if Button.LEFT in hub.buttons.pressed():
        # 數量放在模式 6，要多等約 30 ms，所以按鍵才讀 / counts are in mode 6 (30 ms slower): read on demand
        print('16 色裡找到', cam.colors_found(), '色 / colours found;  色 1 有', cam.count(1), '塊 / blobs of colour 1')
    print('---')
    wait(500)
```

</details>

**Step by step**
1. `cam.max_color()`: mode 12 gives **7 colours** on SPIKE, so the loop runs colour 1~7.
2. `cam.xy(c)` returns (X, Y); X = 0 means not found and is skipped.
3. `where()` turns pixels into words: X < 54 left, > 106 right; Y < 40 top, > 80 bottom.
4. `cam.colors_found()` and `cam.count(1)` are in **mode 6** (about 30 ms slower), so they are read only when you press the button.

**What you should see**: lines like `色 colour 1 : 35 20 左 left, 上 top`, a `---` line between rounds; the hub screen number = colours seen.

**Common problems**
- **A colour never shows?** → it was not taught, or the light changed a lot since; teach it again.
- **Need the area?** → use mode 13 (4 colours + area) or 14 (2 colours + width, height, area).

## Example 3: what colour is at the spot?

**What it does**: reads hue and saturation of spot S1, decides the colour, lights the hub in that colour and prints the colour name.

**Camera mode**: camera mode 2 Spot colour, option 2 Hue + saturation = **mode number 22** (7 spots on SPIKE). S1 is the cross marked 1 on the camera screen.

**You need**: SPIKE hub, camera in port **C**, red, yellow, green, blue, white and black bricks.

**Download**: [ex03_spot_color.py](/examples/unicam/pybricks/ex03_spot_color.py) + [MBC_UniCam.py](/examples/unicam/pybricks/MBC_UniCam.py)

<details>
<summary>🐍 Pybricks code</summary>

```python
# 神攝手通用版 v1 × Pybricks（SPIKE）範例 3：座標取色判斷顏色
# Sharpshooter Vision Universal v1 × Pybricks (SPIKE) example 3: what colour is at the spot?
# 需要把相機選單切到 相機模式 2 座標取色 ・子選項 ② 色相＋飽和 ＝模式編號 22（SPIKE 給 7 點）
# Camera menu: camera mode 2 Spot colour, option 2 Hue + saturation = mode number 22 (7 spots)
# 準備：取樣點 S1 的位置看相機螢幕上標 1 的十字 / spot S1 is the cross marked 1 on the camera screen
# 接線 Wiring：相機 → C 孔 / camera → port C
from pybricks.hubs import PrimeHub
from pybricks.parameters import Port, Color
from pybricks.tools import wait
from MBC_UniCam import UniCam, color_name

hub = PrimeHub()
cam = UniCam(Port.C, mode=22)

# 顏色名稱 → 主機燈號 / colour name -> hub light
LIGHT = {'red': Color.RED, 'orange': Color.ORANGE, 'yellow': Color.YELLOW, 'green': Color.GREEN,
         'cyan': Color.CYAN, 'blue': Color.BLUE, 'purple': Color.VIOLET, 'white': Color.WHITE, 'black': Color.NONE}
NAME = {'red': '紅', 'orange': '橙', 'yellow': '黃', 'green': '綠', 'cyan': '青',
        'blue': '藍', 'purple': '紫', 'white': '白／灰', 'black': '黑'}
LOW_SAT = 15      # 👉 可以改：飽和度比這低就當成白／灰 / below this saturation = white / grey

while True:
    p = cam.hsv(1)                               # 取樣點 S1 的 (色相碼, 飽和度, None) / (hue, sat, None)
    if p is None:                                # 讀不到相機 / no camera
        hub.light.on(Color.NONE)
        wait(200)
        continue
    h, s = p[0], p[1]
    name = color_name(h)
    if s < LOW_SAT and name != 'black':
        name = 'white'                           # 顏色很淡：當成白／灰 / very pale: white / grey
    hub.light.on(LIGHT[name])
    print('S1 色相碼 hue', h, ' 飽和度 sat', s, ' →', NAME[name], name)
    wait(200)
```

</details>

**Step by step**
1. `cam.hsv(1)`: in mode 22 it returns (hue code, saturation, None); value (brightness) needs mode 23.
2. `color_name(h)`: hue code → `'red'`, `'green'`… (red 0~11 or 220~240, orange 12~27, yellow 28~55, green 56~99, cyan 100~139, blue 140~179, purple 180~219, 241~248 white/grey, 249~255 black).
3. A "colour" with saturation < 15 is very pale and is treated as white/grey.

**What you should see**: red brick → red light and `S1 色相碼 hue 3  飽和度 sat 72  → 紅 red`; white paper → white light; black → light off.

**Common problems**
- **Wrong colour?** → look at the printed hue code and change the limits in `color_name()` for your bricks (copy the function into your program), or do the white calibration in the camera SET menu.
- **Many spots at once?** → mode 21 gives 14 spot hues: `for i in range(1, 15): print(cam.hue(i))`.

## Example 4: colour order (WRO)

**What it does**: WRO tasks often need "remember the order of the coloured blocks". The camera sorts the blobs from left to right; the program waits until it reads the same 4 blocks 5 times in a row, beeps, and shows one letter at a time (R red, G green, B blue, Y yellow…).

**Camera mode**: camera mode 3 Colour order (no option) = **mode number 30**; teach every colour that can appear on the field.

**You need**: SPIKE hub, camera in port **C**, 4 bricks of different colours in a row.

**Download**: [ex04_color_order.py](/examples/unicam/pybricks/ex04_color_order.py) + [MBC_UniCam.py](/examples/unicam/pybricks/MBC_UniCam.py)

<details>
<summary>🐍 Pybricks code</summary>

```python
# 神攝手通用版 v1 × Pybricks（SPIKE）範例 4：照順序給色號（WRO 任務：記下積木的顏色順序）
# Sharpshooter Vision Universal v1 × Pybricks (SPIKE) example 4: colour order (WRO: remember the order)
# 需要把相機選單切到 相機模式 3 照順序給色號（沒有子選項）＝模式編號 30
# Camera menu: camera mode 3 Colour order (no option) = mode number 30
# 準備：在相機上教會場地上會出現的每一種顏色 / teach every colour that can appear on the field
# 接線 Wiring：相機 → C 孔 / camera → port C
from pybricks.hubs import PrimeHub
from pybricks.parameters import Port
from pybricks.tools import wait
from MBC_UniCam import UniCam, color_name

hub = PrimeHub()
cam = UniCam(Port.C, mode=30)

WANT = 4          # 👉 可以改：場地上有幾塊 / how many blocks to expect
LETTER = {'red': 'R', 'orange': 'O', 'yellow': 'Y', 'green': 'G', 'cyan': 'C',
          'blue': 'B', 'purple': 'P', 'white': 'W', 'black': 'K'}

# 連續 5 次讀到一樣的順序才算數（避免剛好有手經過）/ same answer 5 times in a row = stable
last = None
same = 0
names = []
while same < 5:
    hues = cam.order()                           # 由左到右每塊的色相碼 / hue codes from left to right
    names = [color_name(h) for h in hues] if hues else []
    if len(names) == WANT and names == last:
        same += 1
    else:
        same = 0
    last = names
    wait(50)

print('順序 order:', names)
hub.speaker.beep()
for n in names:                                  # 一個字母一個字母顯示 / show one letter at a time
    hub.display.char(LETTER[n])
    wait(700)
hub.display.off()
```

</details>

**Step by step**
1. `cam.order()`: hue codes from the left (up to 13 on SPIKE). The hue code is the one of the **taught** colour, so the same colour always gives the same number.
2. `cam.total()`: total blocks in the picture (can be more than 13).
3. `WANT = 4`: the number of blocks on the field; if the count is different or the order still changes, it starts counting again.

**What you should see**: about half a second after the bricks are in place it beeps and shows `R`, `G`, `B`, `Y`; the computer prints `順序 order: ['red', 'green', 'blue', 'yellow']`.

**Common problems**
- **Never beeps?** → the count is not `WANT`: check the order numbers drawn on the camera screen; move same-colour things out of the background or raise the target Size.
- **Two similar colours become one?** → make the Hue range smaller when teaching.

## Example 5: PD line following + stop at a junction

**What it does**: PD line following that mostly uses the near offset and turns early with the far offset; stops and beeps at a cross or T junction; if the line leaves the picture it turns back toward the side where it was lost.

**Camera mode**: camera mode 4 Line, option 1 Black line = **mode number 41** (white line 42, colour line 43: only change `mode=`; colour line = target colour 1).

**You need**: SPIKE hub, driving base (left wheel **E**, right wheel **F**), camera in port **C** at the front looking down and forward, a black line on white with one cross junction.

**Download**: [ex05_line_follow.py](/examples/unicam/pybricks/ex05_line_follow.py) + [MBC_UniCam.py](/examples/unicam/pybricks/MBC_UniCam.py)

<details>
<summary>🐍 Pybricks code</summary>

```python
# 神攝手通用版 v1 × Pybricks（SPIKE）範例 5：PD 循線＋路口停車
# Sharpshooter Vision Universal v1 × Pybricks (SPIKE) example 5: PD line following + stop at a junction
# 需要把相機選單切到 相機模式 4 循線 ・子選項 ① 黑線 ＝模式編號 41（白線 42、色線 43 寫法一樣，改 mode）
# Camera menu: camera mode 4 Line, option 1 Black line = mode number 41 (42 white / 43 colour line: change mode)
# 準備：相機裝在車頭、斜斜往前下方看線 / mount the camera at the front, looking down and forward
# 接線 Wiring：相機 → C 孔；左輪 E、右輪 F / camera → port C; left wheel E, right wheel F
# 方向：站在車後往前看，線在左＝負 / standing behind the robot: line on the left = negative
from pybricks.hubs import PrimeHub
from pybricks.pupdevices import Motor
from pybricks.parameters import Port, Direction
from pybricks.robotics import DriveBase
from pybricks.tools import wait
from MBC_UniCam import UniCam

hub = PrimeHub()
cam = UniCam(Port.C, mode=41)
left = Motor(Port.E, Direction.COUNTERCLOCKWISE)
right = Motor(Port.F)
robot = DriveBase(left, right, 56, 112)

SPEED = 120       # 👉 可以改：前進速度 mm/s / forward speed
KP = 1.5          # 👉 可以改：偏多少就轉多少 / proportional gain
KD = 4.0          # 👉 可以改：偏移變快時多修一點 / derivative gain
last_error = 0

while True:
    v = cam.line_all()                           # 14 個值一次讀 / all 14 line values at once
    if v is None:                                # 讀不到相機：停車 / no camera: stop
        robot.stop()
        wait(50)
        continue
    near, far, flags, junction, lost = v[0], v[2], v[5], v[6], v[13]
    if junction in (1, 2):                       # 1 十字、2 T 字路口：停車嗶一聲 / cross or T junction: stop
        robot.stop()
        hub.speaker.beep()
        break
    if flags == 0:                               # 近中遠都沒看到線：往最後離線那一邊找 / line lost: search
        robot.drive(0, -120 if lost == 1 else 120)
        wait(10)
        continue
    error = 0.7 * near + 0.3 * far               # 近處為主、遠處提早轉彎 / mostly near, a bit of far
    turn = KP * error + KD * (error - last_error)
    last_error = error
    robot.drive(SPEED, turn)                     # 線在左（負）→ 往左轉 / line on the left → turn left
    wait(10)
```

</details>

**Step by step**
1. `cam.line_all()`: 14 values at once: `[0]` near offset, `[2]` far offset, `[5]` line flags (near 1 + mid 2 + far 4), `[6]` junction type (0 none 1 cross 2 T 3 left 4 right 5 end), `[13]` last lost side (1 left 2 right).
2. `error = 0.7 × near + 0.3 × far`: line on the left is negative → negative turn = turn left.
3. `KD × (error − last error)`: when the offset changes fast (a curve is coming) it corrects more, so the robot wobbles less.

**What you should see**: the robot follows the black line and starts turning before a curve; at the cross junction it stops, beeps, and the program ends.

**Common problems**
- **Wobbles a lot?** → smaller `KP`, bigger `KD`, or a slower `SPEED`.
- **Runs off in curves?** → give the far offset more weight (for example 0.5 / 0.5).
- **Stops before the junction?** → the junction threshold is inside the camera and was not tuned on hardware yet; add `cam.junction_dist() < 40` to the `if junction in (1, 2)` test (stop only when the junction is close).

---

## LEGO SPIKE App (Education) Python examples

The official App sees the camera as a "colour sensor". Python reads **bytes 0~7** with `color_sensor.color()`, `reflection()` and `rgbi()` (colour, reflection, raw red/green/blue). The reading helper `UniCamApp` at the top of each example splits them by mode (helper alone: [MBC_UniCam_App_helper.py](/examples/unicam/spike_app/MBC_UniCam_App_helper.py)). Bytes 8~15 may only be readable with `device.data()`; **not yet verified on hardware (task #77)**, so the helper does not use them.

| Helper method | Returns | Modes |
|---|---|---|
| `update()` | read once (call it every loop first) | all |
| `cell(c)` | grid cell (X, Y) of colour c: 13/14 use 16×12 (colours 1~4 / 1~2), 11/12 use 8×6 (colours 1~7); (0, 0) = not found | 11~14 |
| `size_cell(c)`, `colors_found()` | width/height cells (14), colours found (11, 12) | 14 / 11, 12 |
| `hue(i)`, `sat(i)`, `val(i)` | 21: hue of spots 1~6; 22, 23: hue + sat of spots 1~3; 23: value of spot 1 | 21~23 |
| `order()` | (hue codes of the first 6 blocks, total) | 30 |
| `line()` | (near offset, far offset, angle, junction type, near width) | 41~43 |

### App example 1: turn to follow a colour blob

**Camera mode**: **mode number 13** (Colour tracking 3). Wiring: camera **C**, left wheel **E**, right wheel **F**. Colour 1 is on a 16×12 grid; the centre is 8.5.

**Download**: [ex01_track_turn.py](/examples/unicam/spike_app/ex01_track_turn.py)

<details>
<summary>🟨 Official App Python code</summary>

```python
# 神攝手通用版 v1 × 樂高官方 SPIKE App（教育版 Python）範例 1：跟著色塊轉
# Sharpshooter Vision Universal v1 × LEGO SPIKE App (Education, Python) example 1: turn to follow a colour blob
# 需要把相機選單切到 相機模式 1 顏色追蹤 ・子選項 ③ 標準（XY＋面積）＝模式編號 13
# Camera menu: camera mode 1 Colour tracking, option 3 Standard (XY + area) = mode number 13
# 準備：先在相機上教「目標 1」的顏色 / teach "target 1" on the camera first
# 接線 Wiring：相機 → C 孔；左輪 E、右輪 F（驅動底座）/ camera → port C; left wheel E, right wheel F
# 用法：SPIKE App 新增「Python」專案，整支貼上 / new Python project in the SPIKE App, paste all of this
# ===== 神攝手通用版 讀值小工具（樂高官方 SPIKE App 3 教育版 Python，照抄就好、不用改）=====
# ===== UniCam reading helper (LEGO SPIKE App 3, Education, Python: copy as is) =====
# 相機在 SPIKE App 裡是「顏色感應器」：顏色、反射光、原始紅／綠／藍 這 5 個數字（byte 0~7）積木與 Python 都讀得到。
# byte 8~15 只有 App Python 的 device.data() 可能讀得到，還沒上機確認（任務 #77），這個小工具不用它。
# The camera shows up as a colour sensor: colour, reflection, raw red/green/blue (bytes 0~7).
# Bytes 8~15 may only be readable with device.data() (not yet verified, #77); this helper does not use them.
# mode = 你在相機選單切的模式編號（相機模式×10＋子選項，例 13）/ mode = camera menu mode number
import color_sensor


class UniCamApp:
    def __init__(self, port_number, mode):
        self.port = port_number
        self.mode = mode
        self.b = [0] * 8                      # byte 0~7

    def update(self):
        """讀一次最新資料 / read once"""
        c = color_sensor.color(self.port)              # byte 0
        r = color_sensor.reflection(self.port)         # byte 1
        rgb = color_sensor.rgbi(self.port)             # 原始紅、綠、藍（各 2 byte）
        b = [int(c) & 255, int(r) & 255]
        for v in rgb[:3]:
            v = int(v) & 0xFFFF                        # 負數也換回 0~65535
            b += [v & 255, v >> 8]
        self.b = b
        return True

    def _w(self, i):
        # 原始紅（i=0）、綠（1）、藍（2）的 0~65535 / raw red, green, blue word
        return self.b[2 + 2 * i] | (self.b[3 + 2 * i] << 8)

    def cell(self, color):
        """顏色追蹤：色 color 的格子 (X 格, Y 格)，(0, 0)＝沒找到（Y 上＝小）
        模式 13、14：16×12 格（像素 ≈ 格×10−5）；模式 11、12：8×6 格（像素 ≈ 格×20−10），色 1~7"""
        m = self.mode
        if m in (13, 14):
            if color == 1:
                return (self.b[0], self.b[1])
            return (self.b[2 * color - 2], self.b[2 * color - 1])      # 13：色 2~4；14：色 2
        if color == 1:
            g = self.b[1]
        else:
            w = self._w((color - 2) // 2)
            g = w // 100 if color % 2 == 0 else w % 100
        return (g // 10, g % 10)

    def size_cell(self, color):
        """模式 14：色 1、2 的 (寬格, 高格)（16×12 格：寬 ≈ 格×10）"""
        w = self._w(color)                    # 色 1 在原始綠、色 2 在原始藍
        return (w & 255, w >> 8)

    def colors_found(self):
        """模式 11、12：找到幾色（顏色）"""
        return self.b[0]

    def hue(self, point):
        """座標取色：取樣點的色相碼 0~255（21：點 1~6；22、23：點 1~3）"""
        if self.mode == 21:
            return self.b[1 + point]
        return self.b[2 * point]

    def sat(self, point):
        """飽和度（22、23：點 1~3；22 的點 4 在反射光）"""
        if self.mode == 22 and point == 4:
            return self.b[1]
        return self.b[2 * point + 1]

    def val(self, point):
        """明度（23：只有點 1，在反射光；其他點在 byte 8~15）"""
        return self.b[1] if point == 1 else None

    def order(self):
        """照順序給色號：(左起前 6 塊的色相碼, 總塊數)"""
        n = min(6, self.b[0])
        return (self.b[2:2 + n], self.b[0])

    def line(self):
        """循線：(近處偏移, 遠處偏移, 角度, 路口類型, 近處線寬)；偏移、角度 −100~100（線在左＝負）"""
        return (self._w(0) - 100, self._w(1) - 100, self._w(2) - 100, self.b[0], self.b[1])


def color_name(h):
    """色相碼 → 'red' 'orange' 'yellow' 'green' 'cyan' 'blue' 'purple' 'white' 'black'"""
    if h > 248:
        return 'black'
    if h > 240:
        return 'white'
    if h < 12 or h >= 220:
        return 'red'
    if h < 28:
        return 'orange'
    if h < 56:
        return 'yellow'
    if h < 100:
        return 'green'
    if h < 140:
        return 'cyan'
    if h < 180:
        return 'blue'
    return 'purple'
# ===== 小工具到這裡結束 / end of helper =====
from hub import port, light_matrix
import motor_pair
import runloop

cam = UniCamApp(port.C, 13)                       # 模式編號要跟相機選單一樣 / must match the camera menu
BASE = 200        # 👉 可以改：前進速度（度／秒）/ forward speed (deg/s)
K = 40            # 👉 可以改：偏 1 格多轉多少 / turn per grid cell of error


async def main():
    motor_pair.pair(motor_pair.PAIR_1, port.E, port.F)
    while True:
        cam.update()
        cx, cy = cam.cell(1)                      # 色 1 的格子：X 1~16、Y 1~12；(0, 0) = 沒看到 / grid cell
        if cx == 0:                               # 沒看到：原地轉著找 / not seen: spin to search
            motor_pair.move_tank(motor_pair.PAIR_1, 120, -120)
            light_matrix.write('?')
        else:
            error = cx - 8.5                      # 畫面中間 = 8.5 格；在右 → 正 / centre = 8.5; right = positive
            motor_pair.move_tank(motor_pair.PAIR_1, int(BASE + K * error), int(BASE - K * error))
            light_matrix.write(str(cx))
        await runloop.sleep_ms(30)

runloop.run(main())
```

</details>

**What you should see**: blob on the left → the robot turns left; on the right → turns right; the hub screen shows the X cell of colour 1 (1~16); nothing seen → `?` and it spins.

### App example 2: PD line following + stop at a junction

**Camera mode**: **mode number 41** (Line 1, black). The official App gets near offset, far offset, angle, junction type and near width (offsets and angle are sent + 100; the helper subtracts it).

**Download**: [ex02_line_follow.py](/examples/unicam/spike_app/ex02_line_follow.py)

<details>
<summary>🟨 Official App Python code</summary>

```python
# 神攝手通用版 v1 × 樂高官方 SPIKE App（教育版 Python）範例 2：PD 循線＋路口停車
# Sharpshooter Vision Universal v1 × LEGO SPIKE App (Education, Python) example 2: PD line following + stop at a junction
# 需要把相機選單切到 相機模式 4 循線 ・子選項 ① 黑線 ＝模式編號 41（白線 42、色線 43 也一樣）
# Camera menu: camera mode 4 Line, option 1 Black line = mode number 41 (42 / 43 work the same)
# 準備：相機裝在車頭、斜斜往前下方看線 / camera at the front, looking down and forward
# 接線 Wiring：相機 → C 孔；左輪 E、右輪 F / camera → port C; left wheel E, right wheel F
# 方向：站在車後往前看，線在左＝負 / standing behind the robot: line on the left = negative
# ===== 神攝手通用版 讀值小工具（樂高官方 SPIKE App 3 教育版 Python，照抄就好、不用改）=====
# ===== UniCam reading helper (LEGO SPIKE App 3, Education, Python: copy as is) =====
# 相機在 SPIKE App 裡是「顏色感應器」：顏色、反射光、原始紅／綠／藍 這 5 個數字（byte 0~7）積木與 Python 都讀得到。

import color_sensor


class UniCamApp:
    def __init__(self, port_number, mode):

    def update(self):

            v = int(v) & 0xFFFF                        # 負數也換回 0~65535
            b += [v & 255, v >> 8]
        self.b = b
        return True

    def _w(self, i):
        # 原始紅（i=0）、綠（1）、藍（2）的 0~65535 / raw red, green, blue word
        return self.b[2 + 2 * i] | (self.b[3 + 2 * i] << 8)

        模式 13、14：16×12 格（像素 ≈ 格×10−5）；模式 11、12：8×6 格（像素 ≈ 格×20−10），色 1~7"""

            return (self.b[2 * color - 2], self.b[2 * color - 1])      # 13：色 2~4；14：色 2

        return (w & 255, w >> 8)

        return self.b[0]

    def hue(self, point):

        if self.mode == 21:

        return self.b[2 * point]

    if h > 248:
        return 'black'
    if h > 240:

        return 'red'

        return 'orange'

# ===== 小工具到這裡結束 / end of helper =====
from hub import port, light_matrix, sound
import motor_pair
import runloop

cam = UniCamApp(port.C, 41)
BASE = 250        # 👉 可以改：前進速度（度／秒）/ forward speed (deg/s)
KP = 3            # 👉 可以改：比例 / proportional gain
KD = 8            # 👉 可以改：微分 / derivative gain


async def main():
    motor_pair.pair(motor_pair.PAIR_1, port.E, port.F)
    last_error = 0
    while True:
        cam.update()
        near, far, angle, junction, width = cam.line()   # 偏移 −100~100、路口類型、線寬 %
        if junction in (1, 2):                    # 1 十字、2 T 字路口：停車嗶一聲 / cross or T: stop
            motor_pair.stop(motor_pair.PAIR_1)
            await sound.beep(880, 300, 100)
            break
        if width == 0:                            # 近處看不到線：往上一次偏的那邊找 / line lost: search
            turn = -150 if last_error < 0 else 150
            motor_pair.move_tank(motor_pair.PAIR_1, turn, -turn)
        else:
            error = 0.7 * near + 0.3 * far        # 近處為主、遠處提早轉彎 / mostly near, a bit of far
            turn = KP * error + KD * (error - last_error)
            last_error = error
            motor_pair.move_tank(motor_pair.PAIR_1, int(BASE + turn), int(BASE - turn))
        light_matrix.write(str(junction))
        await runloop.sleep_ms(20)

runloop.run(main())
```

</details>

**What you should see**: the robot follows the line and the hub screen shows the junction type (0 = none); at a cross or T junction it stops and beeps. When the near width is 0 (no line) it turns toward the side of the last error.

<a id="app-table"></a>

## Official App block table

### Education (SPIKE App 3, yellow hub)

Colour and reflection are 1 byte each; raw red/green/blue are 2 bytes each: "A + B ×256" means A = `raw red % 256` (remainder) and B = `raw red ÷ 256` (whole number); "A ×100 + B" means split with `÷100`. Grid Y: top = small. Spot colour 1: two spot hues per value.

| Mode | colour | reflection | raw red | raw green | raw blue |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1-1 Max colours | colours found | colour 1 X×10+Y (8×6) | colour 2 X×10+Y (8×6) ×100 + colour 3 X×10+Y (8×6) | colour 4 X×10+Y (8×6) ×100 + colour 5 X×10+Y (8×6) | colour 6 X×10+Y (8×6) ×100 + colour 7 X×10+Y (8×6) |
| 1-2 Multi | colours found | colour 1 X×10+Y (8×6) | colour 2 X×10+Y (8×6) ×100 + colour 3 X×10+Y (8×6) | colour 4 X×10+Y (8×6) ×100 + colour 5 X×10+Y (8×6) | colour 6 X×10+Y (8×6) ×100 + colour 7 X×10+Y (8×6) |
| 1-3 Standard | colour 1 X (16 cells) | colour 1 Y (12 cells) | colour 2 X (16 cells) + colour 2 Y (12 cells) ×256 | colour 3 X (16 cells) + colour 3 Y (12 cells) ×256 | colour 4 X (16 cells) + colour 4 Y (12 cells) ×256 |
| 1-4 Fine | colour 1 X (16 cells) | colour 1 Y (12 cells) | colour 2 X (16 cells) + colour 2 Y (12 cells) ×256 | colour 1 width (16 cells) + colour 1 height (12 cells) ×256 | colour 2 width (16 cells) + colour 2 height (12 cells) ×256 |
| 2-1 Hue | — | — | S1 hue + S2 hue ×256 | S3 hue + S4 hue ×256 | S5 hue + S6 hue ×256 |
| 2-2 Hue+Sat | — | S4 sat | S1 hue + S1 sat ×256 | S2 hue + S2 sat ×256 | S3 hue + S3 sat ×256 |
| 2-3 Hue+Sat+Val | — | S1 val | S1 hue + S1 sat ×256 | S2 hue + S2 sat ×256 | S3 hue + S3 sat ×256 |
| 3 Colour order | total blocks | — | block 1 hue + block 2 hue ×256 | block 3 hue + block 4 hue ×256 | block 5 hue + block 6 hue ×256 |
| 4 Line (1/2/3 same) | junction type | near width % | near offset + 100 | far offset + 100 | line angle + 100 |

### Robot Inventor (Robot Inventor App, teal hub)

On Robot Inventor the colour is only 0~10, reflection up to 126 and raw red/green/blue 0~255, so each value holds one number (or "A ×10 + B", split with `÷10`). Grid 8×6, Y top = small.

| Mode | colour | reflection | raw red | raw green | raw blue |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1-1 Max colours | colour 1 X (8 cells) | colour 1 Y (6 cells) | colour 2 X (8 cells) ×10 + colour 2 Y (6 cells) | colour 3 X (8 cells) ×10 + colour 3 Y (6 cells) | colour 4 X (8 cells) ×10 + colour 4 Y (6 cells) |
| 1-2 Multi | colour 1 X (8 cells) | colour 1 Y (6 cells) | colour 2 X (8 cells) ×10 + colour 2 Y (6 cells) | colour 3 X (8 cells) ×10 + colour 3 Y (6 cells) | colour 4 X (8 cells) ×10 + colour 4 Y (6 cells) |
| 1-3 Standard | colour 1 X (8 cells) | colour 1 Y (6 cells) | colour 2 X (8 cells) ×10 + colour 2 Y (6 cells) | colour 3 X (8 cells) ×10 + colour 3 Y (6 cells) | colour 4 X (8 cells) ×10 + colour 4 Y (6 cells) |
| 1-4 Fine | colour 1 X (8 cells) | colour 1 Y (6 cells) | colour 2 X (8 cells) ×10 + colour 2 Y (6 cells) | colour 1 width (8 cells) ×10 + colour 1 height (6 cells) | colour 2 width (8 cells) ×10 + colour 2 height (6 cells) |
| 2-1 Hue | — | S4 hue ÷ 2 | S1 hue | S2 hue | S3 hue |
| 2-2 Hue+Sat | — | S2 sat | S1 hue | S1 sat | S2 hue |
| 2-3 Hue+Sat+Val | — | S2 sat÷10×10 + val÷10 | S1 hue | S1 sat÷10×10 + val÷10 | S2 hue |
| 3 Colour order | — | total blocks | block 1 hue | block 2 hue | block 3 hue |
| 4 Line (1/2/3 same) | junction type | near width % | near offset + 100 | far offset + 100 | line angle + 100 |

> [!CAUTION]
> In the official App **do not use the "colour is [red]?" block**: it compares LEGO's own colour numbers. Always put the number in a variable and compare. The Robot Inventor App's Python reading is not verified yet; this page only lists the block reading.

## Please note

- **Nothing here has run on hardware yet**: the byte layout was checked on a computer against the independent reference implementation of the spec; KP/KD, area limits and the junction stop are suggestions, print the numbers first and then tune.
- When you change the camera mode, change `mode=` too (SPIKE cannot read the camera's mode).
- If the hub disconnects, the hub name at the top left of the camera screen turns red; just run the program again.
